11072|15d6b2ff.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|15d6b2ff.text: Your skills are truly becoming extraordinary. Now, let us continue your training...

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|6928abbf.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

264|b3b21323.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
264|b3b21323.text: At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

6826|f676e73a.name: Talvash del Kissel
6826|f676e73a.text: Um, hello!  If you are here about fee collection and/or a summons, then you must have me mistaken for someone else.  Terribly sorry!

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

2922-progress.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2922-progress.text: Did you find Techbot?  Did you retrieve its memory core??
2922-progress.title: Save Techbot's Brain!

2924-progress.name: Klockmort Spannerspan
2924-progress.text: Do you have the essential artificials?
2924-progress.title: Essential Artificials

2930-progress.name: Master Mechanic Castpipe
2930-progress.text: Do you have the prismatic punch card??
2930-progress.title: Data Rescue

2945-progress.name: Unknown
2945-progress.text:
The gnomish contraption before you bears a plaque calling it "The Sparklematic 5200".  The gist of the machine, from reading the instructions below the plaque, is to scrub away dirt that an item might have.  The machine has a coin slot, accepting three silver coins to start the process once the item is placed inside it.

It would seem as though the grime-encrusted ring you found earlier is just the thing to try in this machine!
2945-progress.title: Grime-Encrusted Ring

2947-progress.name: Talvash del Kissel
2947-progress.text:
Hey, easy there partner - I'm a very important businessman!  I am sure that the courier is just simply late with the delivery of the rent... wait... you're not my landlord.

Well, of course you aren't - silly me!  You've come to me seeking the finest jeweler in all of Ironforge, one who does NOT make CURSED items!  Yes!

Um... what do you need?
2947-progress.title: Return of the Ring

2953-progress.name: Unknown
2953-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
2953-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

2962-progress.name: Ozzie Togglevolt
2962-progress.text: Hrm, you're not glowing. That's a good sign.
2962-progress.title: The Only Cure is More Green Glow

4601-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
4601-progress.text: It would seem that the device needs some sort of grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to get the contraption working.  So long as both are present, the Sparklematic 5200 should work...
4601-progress.title: The Sparklematic 5200!

4603-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4603-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

4604-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
4604-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4604-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

78146-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78146-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78146-progress.title: Goaz Scrolls

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
80-progress.text: Back again, $N?  What do you have this time?
80-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan
